profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Technology agnostic problem solver with strengths in cloud infrastructure, data processing, scalability
and observability. Enjoys building impactful systems, leveraging best practices and collaboration

Infrastructure - Ansible, SaltStack, Terraform, Jenkins, Linux, Microsoft, Azure, AWS, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, Kubernetes, GitOps, Observability 
Data - ETLs, Hive, Spark, Airflow, Redshift, MySQL, Python, Scala, Java, Superset, EMR, Databricks, Sagemaker, Zeppelin 
Backend - SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis/RLEC, Celery, RabbitMQ, MySQL, Flask, Django

positions.title: Senior Platform Engineer
positions.description: Scalable automation with cloud-native solutions for Rally Here https://rallyhere.gg/ (technology platform serving various game studios)
positions.insights: Skills: Vault · Microsoft Azure · TeamCity · Kubernetes · Terraform · SaltStack · Consul · HashiCorp

positions.title: Data Infrastructure and Platform Senior Engineer
positions.description: Building out infrastructure for data science and engineering with AWS, EMR, Hive, Redshift, Spark, Databricks, Scala, Python, Java, Ansible and Terraform

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Scaled pricing system to support 10x load while maintaining latency (40ms)
-Load tested system quarterly by simulating 10x RPS
-Tested and profiled possible optimizations--server-side Redis commands, caching, etc

company.name: AdRoll, a Division of NextRoll, Inc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Create object-oriented models, RESTful APIs and relational database schema 
-Support async and distributed systems through messaging, serverless APIs, queues and task systems 
-Design error-tolerant systems that connect internal and external APIs, instrumented with monitoring tools

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
- Liaison between internal engineering and business teams in bug diagnosis and resolution
- Identified and reported on internal technical issues with SQL, Tableau and Datadog
- Write Python scripts to automate API calls across 20,000 advertiser accounts

positions.title: Princeton-in-Asia Fellow
positions.description: Merit-based grant for university English instruction with content focused on technology influencing culture

positions.description: Merit-based grant for technology driven cultural ambassadorship in rural Taiwan
